findings.description: F-001: all three figures (x-turn.png, o-turn.png, mid-game.png) were missing the status line their captions describe; x-turn.png was byte-identical to empty-board.png, new-round.png, new-match.png and scoreboard.png.
findings.resolution: Root cause fixed in tic_tac_toe.py (StringVar now takes master=root, so the ttk.Labels no longer watch a variable in the basic module's interpreter) and all 26 assets regenerated. Verified: no Pro screenshot has a blank status band, and scoreboard/new-round/tic-tac-toe-pro are now distinct from the states they were duplicating.

findings.description: F-025: the object_diagram labelled 'GameState' omitted the draws field that the canonical dataclass and 17.19 both declare.
findings.resolution: Added ('draws', '0') to the object_diagram in build_13() so the preview matches the eight-field dataclass that 17.26 later depends on. Chapter HTML rebuilt.
